questions.statement: Which animal is long, has no legs and moves on the ground?
questions.context: En una caminata por la selva del Chocó, el guía pide a los niños tener cuidado con un animal largo que se arrastra por el suelo.

options.feedback: Correct. A snake is long, has no legs and moves by sliding on the ground.
Incorrect. A parrot is a bird with two legs and wings, so it does have legs.
Incorrect. A monkey has arms and legs and climbs trees.
Incorrect. A toucan is a bird with legs, wings and a big beak.

questions.explanation: "Snake" significa serpiente o culebra. Es el único animal de la lista que no tiene patas ("no legs") y se arrastra por el suelo. El loro ("parrot") y el tucán ("toucan") son aves y el mono ("monkey") tiene brazos y piernas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which bird has a very big and colorful beak?
questions.context: En el Parque Tayrona, los niños ven en un árbol un ave negra con un pico enorme de colores amarillo y naranja.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A frog is a small green animal that jumps; it is not a bird and has no beak.
Incorrect. A jaguar is a big wild cat with spots, not a bird with a beak.
Incorrect. A sloth is a slow animal with fur that hangs in trees, and it has no beak.
Correct. The toucan is a bird famous for its very big and colorful beak.

questions.explanation: "Toucan" significa tucán. Es un ave ("bird") que vive en los bosques de Colombia y se reconoce por su pico ("beak") grande y de colores. Los otros animales de la lista no son aves.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "The ______ is very slow. It hangs in the trees and sleeps a lot."
questions.context: En Leticia, en el Amazonas, una guía muestra a los turistas un animal que se mueve muy despacio colgado de una rama.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A jaguar is a fast hunter that runs and jumps, so it is not "very slow".
Incorrect. A parrot is a bird that flies, and it does not hang slowly from branches.
Correct. The sloth is the slowest animal of the rainforest and it hangs from trees and sleeps many hours.
Incorrect. A frog jumps fast and lives near water, so it does not hang in the trees all day.

questions.explanation: "Sloth" significa perezoso, un animal del Amazonas que se mueve muy lento ("very slow"), cuelga de los árboles ("hangs in the trees") y duerme mucho. Las pistas de la oración describen justo a este animal.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "A parrot has wings. It ______ fly."
questions.context: En los Llanos Orientales, una bandada de loros verdes vuela sobre el río al atardecer.

options.feedback: Correct. A parrot uses its wings to fly, so we say "It can fly".
Incorrect. "Can't" means it is not able, but a parrot has wings and flies.
Incorrect. "It is fly" mixes "is" with the action "fly"; to talk about ability we use "can".
Incorrect. "Are" goes with you, we and they, and "It are fly" has no meaning about ability.

questions.explanation: Para decir que un animal puede hacer algo usamos "can" + acción: "It can fly" (puede volar). Para decir que no puede usamos "can't". Como el loro tiene alas ("wings"), sí puede volar.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Guide: "Look! This animal is a big wild cat. It is yellow with black spots."
Boy: "Is it a ______?"
questions.context: En un recorrido por la selva del Amazonas, un guía describe a un gran felino que vive en Colombia.

options.feedback: Incorrect. A monkey is a primate with long arms, not a big cat with spots.
Incorrect. A parrot is a green bird, so it is not a yellow cat with black spots.
Incorrect. A crocodile is a reptile with green scales, not a cat with spots.
Correct. The jaguar is the big wild cat of the Amazon, yellow with black spots.

questions.explanation: Las pistas son "big wild cat" (gran gato salvaje) y "yellow with black spots" (amarillo con manchas negras). Ese animal es el jaguar, que en inglés se escribe igual: "jaguar". Es el felino más grande de América.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "Frogs are small and green. They can jump and swim, but they can't fly."
Which sentence is true about frogs?
questions.context: En una laguna cerca de Florencia, Caquetá, los niños leen un cartel sobre las ranas del lugar.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says frogs are "small", the opposite of big.
Incorrect. The text says "they can't fly", so flying is not something frogs do.
Correct. The text says "They can jump and swim", so frogs are able to swim.
Incorrect. The text describes frogs as "green", not yellow.

questions.explanation: El texto dice lo que las ranas pueden hacer con "can" (saltar y nadar) y lo que no pueden con "can't" (volar). También dice que son pequeñas y verdes. Solo "Frogs can swim" coincide con el texto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "In the Amazonas, Pedro sees a monkey and a crocodile. The monkey climbs a tree. The crocodile swims in the river."
What does the monkey do?
questions.context: Pedro viaja en lancha por el río Amazonas cerca de Puerto Nariño y ve dos animales salvajes.

options.feedback: Incorrect. In the text the crocodile is the animal that swims in the river, not the monkey.
Correct. The text says "The monkey climbs a tree".
Incorrect. Monkeys have no wings, and the text never says any animal flies.
Incorrect. The text does not mention sleeping, and the monkey is in a tree, not in the water.

questions.explanation: El texto habla de dos animales y cada uno hace algo distinto: el mono ("monkey") trepa un árbol ("climbs a tree") y el cocodrilo ("crocodile") nada en el río ("swims in the river"). No hay que mezclar las acciones de los dos animales.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: En una feria de ciencias en Villavicencio, los niños revisan carteles sobre lo que pueden hacer los animales salvajes de Colombia.

options.text: A sloth can run very fast.
options.feedback: Incorrect. A sloth is very slow, so it can't run fast.
Correct. Crocodiles live in rivers and swim very well, so the sentence is true.
Incorrect. A snake has no wings, so it can't fly; it moves on the ground.
Incorrect. Monkeys use their arms, legs and tail to climb trees, so "can't climb" is false.

questions.explanation: Para evaluar cada oración pensamos en cómo es cada animal. El perezoso es lento, la serpiente no tiene alas y el mono trepa muy bien. El cocodrilo vive en los ríos y nada, por eso "A crocodile can swim" es la oración correcta.
questions.subject: ingles
